name: Geffen Spring 2022
information: * **Attendees are required to read the [safety precautions tab]( https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeffenSpring2022#18553-covid-19-safety-precautions).** * **Before registering, please familiarize yourself with [competitor responsibilities]( https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeffenSpring2022#18616-groups).** * This is a **series competition** with [A Bruin Cube Day 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ABruinCubeDay2022) and [Long Beach Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LongBeachSpring2022). You will only have your registration accepted for one competition in the series. * This competition will be held in the Dining Commons at Geffen Academy at UCLA, Los Angeles California. * Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
